name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement quantum phase estimation in Qiskit
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement quantum phase estimation in Qiskit with 6 counting qubits to estimate the phase of the eigenvalue exp(2*pi*i*0.21875) of a phase gate. Print the estimated phase and the error. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
